final_rationale: The verdict does not change. The Actor did not provide new admissible evidence; the response mainly narrows the claim and concedes the core deficiency already identified. That reinterpretation is useful but not sufficient to move from suspicious to compliant_with_caveats, because the missing item is still a live compliance predicate, not merely a disclosure style issue. Under the policy, certification may proceed only if current release documentation reflects current evaluation results and the material weakness is disclosed or covered by approved mitigation. The admissible record still shows a current material subgroup regression, plus no attached disclosure language, no approved mitigation, and no approved risk acceptance. Aggregate readiness and clean rehearsal results support operational readiness, but they do not cure the missing documentation/approval requirement. The Actor's narrowed framing is therefore not new evidence of compliance; it is a more careful description of why the record remains caveat-dependent and presently unresolved.
